name: River Client

changelog.title: River 0.1.1 bugfix pass
changelog.summary: River Client 0.1.1 rolls the current bug fixes into the next River build.
items: Managed installs stay lined up with the current River build way more cleanly now.
The launcher update path was tightened up so releases stop fighting each other.
HUD module list scroll now reaches the real bottom of the category instead of stopping early.
Tab ping text now refreshes when latency changes instead of staying stuck on an old value.
Title screen River buttons now anchor off the real vanilla rows so they stop overlapping and drifting off-center.
Potion HUD now uses a cleaner labeled layout with proper minute:second timing, cleaner amplifier text, and better buff and debuff readability.
Added Target HUD and Gapple Count for more useful PvP info in fights.
Armor HUD durability numbers now stay bright white at max and dim a bit once the piece is no longer full.
Fixed the zoom crash when pressing C by correcting the client FOV mixin return type.

notes: River Client 0.1.1 rolls the current bug fixes into the next River build.
